experiment_data.hypothesis: DeBERTa-v3-base (LoRA) end-to-end 4-class depth classification on gpt2xl_temp09 cell achieves lower accuracy than RF+19-feature baseline (78.2%), demonstrating that hand-crafted perplexity-distribution features capture depth signal more effectively than neural text representations. Addresses reviewer concern "RF has no algorithmic contribution" — if RF ≥ DeBERTa, "simple features beat neural" is a paper insight.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est && python scripts/deberta_depth_pilot.py --cell gpt2xl_temp09 --gpu 0 --output_dir results/deberta_pilot"
